# SiteDokAILab

SiteDokAILab is a free workflow and AI process lab run by Troels Østbjerg while he is looking for his next role.

Core positioning: Free workflow reviews for teams drowning in manual work.

Sharper positioning line: Send me your messy workflow. I will tell you where AI can actually help.

SiteDokAILab does not start with AI tools. It starts with recurring work that wastes time, creates confusion or keeps almost becoming an AI idea.

Language: English.
Primary audience: companies with messy workflows, hiring managers, recruiters and Troels' network.
Company base: Denmark.
Contact email: troelsostbjerg@gmail.com.

## What companies can submit

- Weekly reporting chaos
- Customer requests stuck in inboxes
- Supplier follow-ups
- Repeated meeting notes and action tracking
- Manual spreadsheet updates
- CRM follow-up gaps
- Handover problems
- AI ideas nobody has made concrete yet

## What a mini-review covers

- Diagnosis: what the real problem seems to be
- Workflow sketch: the simple version of the process
- AI fit: where AI could help and where it should not
- Risk / watch-out: what could break, confuse people or create bad automation
- First step: one practical thing the company can do without buying a tool

This is a mini-review, not a full implementation project.

## Method

Mess -> Map -> Simplify -> Assist -> Approve -> Measure.

- Mess: start with the annoying reality, not the tool.
- Map: who does what, where information moves, and where it gets stuck.
- Simplify: remove unnecessary steps before adding AI.
- Assist: decide where AI can summarize, draft, classify, compare, extract or flag.
- Approve: decide where a human must still review, decide or own the outcome.
- Measure: define whether the new workflow saves time, reduces errors or improves decisions.

## Case handling

- Public cases are only published if permission is given.
- Public cases are anonymized.
- Example cases must be labelled as example cases.
- Do not submit confidential, personal or sensitive data.
- Remove names, customer details, financial numbers and internal secrets before submitting.
- Submissions are not sold.
- SiteDokAILab is not legal, compliance, security or financial advice.
